nodes.label: Lead to Cash (L2C)
nodes.description: End-to-end sales order management, pricing, billing, logistics, and customer collections.

nodes.label: Idea to Delivery (I2D)
nodes.description: Transit times, shipping logistics, warehouse operations, and physical goods delivery.

nodes.label: Record to Report (R2R)
nodes.description: Financial accounting, commissions settlement, general ledger, and financial reporting.

nodes.label: Procure to Pay (P2P)
nodes.description: Procurement, vendor purchase orders, goods receipt, and invoice verification.

nodes.label: SAP S/4HANA
nodes.description: Target ERP platform for global sales, billing, master data, and central finance.

nodes.label: SAP ECC
nodes.description: Legacy ERP environment being migrated to SAP S/4HANA under Solvay SPARK.

nodes.label: Salesforce (CRM)
nodes.description: Customer relationship management platform handling customer complaints, accounts, and order intake.

nodes.label: SOVOS (Tax Engine)
nodes.description: Global tax determination and automated electronic compliance engine integrated with billing.

nodes.label: SAP Fiori
nodes.description: Modern UX role-based applications for custom enhancements and business user dashboards.

nodes.label: Solvay@eCommerce
nodes.description: Digital portal for customer direct ordering, product catalog, and invoice visibility.
